name: Microsoft Outlook
label: Microsoft Outlook — Microsoft Graph v1.0 mail/calendar/contacts
description: Microsoft Outlook via the official Microsoft Graph v1.0 mail/calendar/contacts. Base https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-sendmail?view=graph-rest-1.0 and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/mail-api-overview. Graph v1.0 only (no beta). All paths use /me (delegated — a signed-in user). App-only / client-credentials MUST call /users/{id|userPrincipalName}/... instead of /me (/me returns 400 'only valid with delegated authentication'). This node does not swap the path. Mailbox data is personal data. Admin consent for app-only Mail.Send. send-and-wait and listen are BPMN message events, not Graph RPCs. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft Outlook operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | reply-message | get-message | list-messages | update-message | delete-message | move-message | create-draft | send-draft | get-draft | update-draft | delete-draft | add-attachment | get-attachment | list-attachments | download-attachment | create-folder | get-folder | list-folders | update-folder | delete-folder | create-calendar | get-calendar | list-calendars | update-calendar | delete-calendar | create-contact | get-contact | list-contacts | update-contact | delete-contact | send-and-wait | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Graph resource id (message, folder, calendar, contact). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: attachment_id
schema.description: Attachment id for get/download-attachment. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: destinationId
schema.description: Destination mailFolder id for move-message. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: Folder display name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Calendar name or attachment name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Message subject for send-message (sent as message.subject), create-draft, update-draft, update-message. Example: Meet for lunch?

schema.label: message
schema.description: Full Graph Message object for send-message / reply-message. Escape hatch: on send-message the subject, body, toRecipients, ccRecipients and bccRecipients fields are merged into it. Example: {"subject":"Hi","body":{"contentType":"Text","content":"Hello"},"toRecipients":[{"emailAddress":{"address":"ada@example.com"}}]}.

schema.label: saveToSentItems
schema.description: send-message only. Save a copy in Sent Items. Official default true. Example: false.

schema.label: comment
schema.description: Reply comment (plain text) for reply-message. Graph comment field. Example: Thanks — agreed.

schema.label: body
schema.description:
Graph itemBody {contentType, content} (contentType EXACT: Text | HTML) for send-message (sent as message.body), update-message, create-draft, update-draft. Example: {"contentType":"HTML","content":"

Hi

"}.

schema.label: isRead
schema.description: update-message only. Mark the message read/unread. Example: true.

schema.label: categories
schema.description: update-message category strings. Example: ["Blue category"].

schema.label: toRecipients
schema.description: Graph Recipient list for send-message (sent as message.toRecipients; at least one recipient needed), create-draft, update-draft. Example: [{"emailAddress":{"address":"ada@example.com"}}].

schema.label: ccRecipients
schema.description: Cc Recipient list for send-message, create-draft, update-draft. Same shape as toRecipients.

schema.label: bccRecipients
schema.description: Bcc Recipient list for send-message, create-draft, update-draft. Same shape as toRecipients.

schema.label: contentType
schema.description: add-attachment MIME type, and optional Graph itemBody.contentType when included inside message/body. EXACT for mail: Text | HTML. Example: HTML.

schema.label: contentBytes
schema.description: Request-body parameter `contentBytes` for operation: add-attachment.

schema.label: @odata.type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `@odata.type` for operation: add-attachment.

schema.label: givenName
schema.description: Request-body parameter `givenName` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: surname
schema.description: Request-body parameter `surname` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: emailAddresses
schema.description: Request-body parameter `emailAddresses` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: $top
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$top` for operation: list-messages.

schema.label: $filter
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$filter` for operation: list-messages.

schema.label: $select
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$select` for operation: list-messages.

schema.label: $skip
schema.description: Query-string parameter `$skip` for operation: list-messages.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, reply-message, get-message, list-messages, update-message, delete-message, move-message, create-draft, send-draft, get-draft, update-draft, delete-draft, add-attachment, get-attachment, list-attachments, download-attachment, create-folder, get-folder, list-folders, update-folder, delete-folder, create-calendar, get-calendar, list-calendars, update-calendar, delete-calendar, create-contact, get-contact, list-contacts, update-contact, delete-contact, send-and-wait, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Graph access token
configurationParameters.description: Microsoft Graph delegated or app-only access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. Scopes Mail.ReadWrite Mail.Send Calendars.ReadWrite Contacts.ReadWrite as needed. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Graph Client State
configurationParameters.description: Microsoft Graph subscription clientState verified against inbound value[*].clientState. Never logged.
